name: schooly
description: Schooly — SaaS de gestion scolaire multi-établissements (Côte d'Ivoire / Afrique de l'Ouest). Refontiq.

scripts.build: if [ "$VERCEL" = "1" ]; then cd apps/schooly && npx next build; else npm run build --workspace apps/schooly && npm run build --workspace apps/pwa-parent && npm run build --workspace packages/billing; fi
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db --noEmit && tsc -p apps/schooly --noEmit && tsc -p apps/pwa-parent --noEmit && tsc -p packages/billing --noEmit
scripts.db:types: cd packages/db && supabase gen types typescript --local > src/database.types.ts
